title: HAPPY, Happy tidings of the New Year

lines.text: HAPPY, Happy tidings of the New Year
We give praises unto our God
Who spares our lives all to see another year
In the land of the living.
We offer Thee thanks and thanks again
To Him be all glory, power and honour
The Lamb of God on the Throne.
Christ Jesus our light and protector be
Thy fold establish our plea
Gainful employment provide for the jobless
Divinely heal the sick.
The Lord God shall surely my Shepherd be
Therefore I shall nothing lack
He make me in the green pasture to lie
And gently restores my soul.
Even though if I shall have to walk through
The valley of shadow of death
Verily, verily I fear no evil
For always He is with us.
Thy rod and Thy staff yea all of them both
They all soothe and comfort my soul
Thou preparest a table before me
In the presence of my foes.
Thou anointest my head with precious oil
And cup of my joy overflows
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me
Yea all the days of my life.
Christ Jesus our Saviour Lord, O! we plead
The Holy Ghost on us descend
That we may be decked in Thy sacred cloak
When our sojour here shall end.
We hail Thee, Majesty, Excellent King
Holy Eternal Trinity
Thy Victory grant to us in tempting hour
May we from satan be free.
Holy Father in heaven oh we plead
Bless us, ere from earth depart
Christ Jesus the cause Thy children plead
May we reign above with Thee.
